source: Server_configuration.txt derived from ark.wiki.gg Server configuration
curation: ChatGPT curated from DeepSeek extraction; no undocumented source gaps were invented.

load_policy.dynamic_config: load only for explicit dynamic/live requests
load_policy.content_niche: load only for clearly matching niche/map/content requests

safety_rules: unsupported, obsolete and unverified settings are rejected for automatic application.
AI output never writes INI directly; it must pass structured validation and preview.

settings.name: BabyCuddleGracePeriodMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how long after delaying cuddling before Imprinting Quality starts to decrease.

settings.name: BabyCuddleIntervalMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how often babies need attention for imprinting.

settings.name: BabyCuddleLoseImprintQualitySpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how fast Imprinting Quality decreases after grace period.

settings.name: BabyFoodConsumptionSpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the speed that baby tames eat their food.

settings.name: BabyImprintAmountMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the percentage each imprint provides.

settings.name: BabyImprintingStatScaleMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how much effect Imprinting Quality has on stats.

settings.name: BabyMatureSpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the maturation speed of babies.

settings.name: bAllowFlyerSpeedLeveling
settings.description: Specifies whether flyer creatures can have Movement Speed levelled. In ASA, this only works if bAllowSpeedLeveling is also True.

settings.name: bAllowSpeedLeveling
settings.description: Specifies whether players and non-flyer creatures can have Movement Speed levelled.

settings.name: bAllowUnlimitedRespecs
settings.description: If True, allows more than one usage of Mindwipe Tonic without 24 hours cooldown.

settings.name: bDisableDinoBreeding
settings.description: If True, prevents tames from being bred.

settings.name: bDisableDinoRiding
settings.description: If True, prevents players from riding tames.

settings.name: bDisableDinoTaming
settings.description: If True, prevents players from taming wild creatures.

settings.name: bDisableFriendlyFire
settings.description: If True, prevents Friendly-Fire among tribe mates/tames/structures.

settings.name: bDisableStructurePlacementCollision
settings.description: If True, allows structures to clip into the terrain.

settings.name: bPvEAllowTribeWar
settings.description: If False, disables capability for Tribes to officially declare war.

settings.name: bPvEAllowTribeWarCancel
settings.description: If True, allows cancellation of an agreed-upon war before it has started.

settings.name: bPvEDisableFriendlyFire
settings.description: If True, disabled Friendly-Fire in PvE servers.

settings.name: bUseCorpseLocator
settings.description: If False, prevents survivors to see a green light beam at their dead body location.

settings.name: CraftingSkillBonusMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the bonus received from upgrading the Crafting Skill.

settings.name: CraftXPMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the amount of XP earned for crafting.

settings.name: CropDecaySpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the speed of crop decay in plots.

settings.name: CropGrowthSpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the speed of crop growth in plots.

settings.name: DinoHarvestingDamageMultiplier
settings.description: Scales the damage done to a harvestable item by a tame.

settings.name: EggHatchSpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales time needed for fertilised egg to hatch.

settings.name: FishingLootQualityMultiplier
settings.description: Sets quality of items from fishing.

settings.name: FuelConsumptionIntervalMultiplier
settings.description: Defines the interval of fuel consumption.

settings.name: GenericXPMultiplier
settings.description: Scales XP earned for generic XP (automatic over time).

settings.name: GlobalCorpseDecompositionTimeMultiplier
settings.description: Scales decomposition time of corpses globally.

settings.name: GlobalItemDecompositionTimeMultiplier
settings.description: Scales decomposition time of dropped items globally.

settings.name: GlobalSpoilingTimeMultiplier
settings.description: Scales spoiling time of perishables globally.

settings.name: HarvestXPMultiplier
settings.description: Scales XP earned for harvesting.

settings.name: KillXPMultiplier
settings.description: Scales XP earned for a kill.

settings.name: LayEggIntervalMultiplier
settings.description: Scales time between eggs are spawning.

settings.name: MatingIntervalMultiplier
settings.description: Scales interval between tames can mate.

settings.name: MatingSpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Scales speed at which tames mate.

settings.name: MaxNumberOfPlayersInTribe
settings.description: Sets maximum survivors allowed in a tribe. 0 = no limit.

settings.name: OverrideMaxExperiencePointsDino
settings.description: Overrides max XP cap of tame characters.

settings.name: OverrideMaxExperiencePointsPlayer
settings.description: Overrides max XP cap of player characters.

settings.name: PassiveTameIntervalMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how often survivors get tame requests for passive tames.

settings.name: PlayerHarvestingDamageMultiplier
settings.description: Scales damage done to harvestable item by a Player.

settings.name: PoopIntervalMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how frequently survivors can poop.

settings.name: PreventOfflinePvPConnectionInvincibleInterval
settings.description: Specifies time in seconds a player cannot take damage after login.

settings.name: ResourceNoReplenishRadiusPlayers
settings.description: Controls how resources regrow closer or farther away from players.

settings.name: ResourceNoReplenishRadiusStructures
settings.description: Controls how resources regrow closer or farther away from structures.

settings.name: SpecialXPMultiplier
settings.description: Scales XP earned for SpecialEvent.

settings.name: StructureDamageRepairCooldown
settings.description: Cooldown period on structure repair from last damage. 0 to disable.

settings.name: SupplyCrateLootQualityMultiplier
settings.description: Increases quality of items in supply crates.

settings.name: TamedDinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how fast tame creatures consume food.

settings.name: TamedDinoTorporDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how fast tamed creatures lose torpor.

settings.name: WildDinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how fast wild creatures consume food.

settings.name: WildDinoTorporDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Scales how fast wild creatures lose torpor.

settings.name: AdminLogging
settings.description: If True, logs all admin commands to in-game chat.

settings.name: AllowThirdPersonPlayer
settings.description: If False, disables third person camera allowed by default on all dedicated servers.

settings.name: AutoSavePeriodMinutes
settings.description: Set interval for automatic saves. Setting to 0 will cause constant saving.

settings.name: BanListURL
settings.description: Sets the global ban list. The list is fetched every 10 minutes.

settings.name: DayCycleSpeedScale
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the passage of time in the ARK.

settings.name: DayTimeSpeedScale
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the passage of time in the ARK during the day.

settings.name: DifficultyOffset
settings.description: Specifies the difficulty level.

settings.name: DinoCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for creatures' food consumption.

settings.name: DinoCharacterHealthRecoveryMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for creatures' health recovery.

settings.name: DinoCharacterStaminaDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for creatures' stamina consumption.

settings.name: DinoCountMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for creature spawns.

settings.name: DinoDamageMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the damage wild creatures deal.

settings.name: DinoResistanceMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the resistance to damage wild creatures receive.

settings.name: DisableCryopodEnemyCheck
settings.description: If True, allows cryopods to be used while enemies are nearby.

settings.name: DisableCryopodFridgeRequirement
settings.description: If True, allows cryopods to be used without needing to be in range of a powered cryofridge.

settings.name: DisableDinoDecayPvE
settings.description: If True, disables the creature decay in PvE mode.

settings.name: DisableImprintDinoBuff
settings.description: If True, disables the creature imprinting player Stat Bonus.

settings.name: DisableStructureDecayPvE
settings.description: If True, disables the gradual auto-decay of player structures.

settings.name: EnablePvPGamma
settings.description: If True, allows use of console command 'gamma' in PvP mode.

settings.name: HarvestAmountMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for yields from all harvesting activities.

settings.name: HarvestHealthMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the 'health' of items that can be harvested.

settings.name: ItemStackSizeMultiplier
settings.description: Allow increasing or decreasing global item stack size.

settings.name: KickIdlePlayersPeriod
settings.description: Time in seconds after which characters that have not moved or interacted will be kicked (if -EnableIdlePlayerKick set).

settings.name: MaxPersonalTamedDinos
settings.description: Sets a per-tribe creature tame limit. Default 0 disables.

settings.name: MaxPlatformSaddleStructureLimit
settings.description: Changes the maximum number of platformed-creatures/rafts allowed on the ARK.

settings.name: MaxTamedDinos
settings.description: Sets the maximum number of tame creatures on a server, global cap.

settings.name: MinimumDinoReuploadInterval
settings.description: Number of seconds cool-down between allowed creature re-uploads.

settings.name: NightTimeSpeedScale
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the passage of time during night.

settings.name: NonPermanentDiseases
settings.description: If True, makes permanent diseases not permanent. Players lose them on re-spawn.

settings.name: noTributeDownloads
settings.description: If True, prevents CrossArk-data downloads.

settings.name: OverrideOfficialDifficulty
settings.description: Allows you to override the default server difficulty level of 4 with 5. Default 0 disables.

settings.name: OxygenSwimSpeedStatMultiplier
settings.description: Use this to set how swim speed is multiplied by level spent in oxygen.

settings.name: PerPlatformMaxStructuresMultiplier
settings.description: Higher value increases max number of items placeable on saddles and rafts.

settings.name: PlayerCharacterFoodDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for player characters' food consumption.

settings.name: PlayerCharacterHealthRecoveryMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for player characters' health recovery.

settings.name: PlayerCharacterStaminaDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for player characters' stamina consumption.

settings.name: PlayerCharacterWaterDrainMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for player characters' water consumption.

settings.name: PlayerDamageMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the damage players deal.

settings.name: PlayerResistanceMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the resistance to damage players receive.

settings.name: PreventDiseases
settings.description: If True, completely diseases on the server.

settings.name: PreventDownloadDinos
settings.description: If True, prevents creatures download from ARK Data.

settings.name: PreventDownloadItems
settings.description: If True, prevents items download from ARK Data.

settings.name: PreventDownloadSurvivors
settings.description: If True, prevents survivors download from ARK Data.

settings.name: PreventMateBoost
settings.description: If True, disables creature mate boosting.

settings.name: PreventOfflinePvP
settings.description: If True, enables the Offline Raiding Prevention (ORP).

settings.name: PreventOfflinePvPInterval
settings.description: Seconds to wait before ORP becomes active.

settings.name: PreventTribeAlliances
settings.description: If True, prevents tribes from creating Alliances.

settings.name: PreventUploadDinos
settings.description: If True, prevents creatures upload to ARK Data.

settings.name: PreventUploadItems
settings.description: If True, prevents items upload to ARK Data.

settings.name: PreventUploadSurvivors
settings.description: If True, prevents survivors upload to ARK Data.

settings.name: ProximityChat
settings.description: If True, only players near each other can see their chat messages.

settings.name: PvEDinoDecayPeriodMultiplier
settings.description: Creature PvE auto-decay time multiplier. Requires DisableDinoDecayPvE=false.

settings.name: PvEStructureDecayPeriodMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for structures decay times.

settings.name: PvPDinoDecay
settings.description: If True, enables creatures' decay in PvP while ORP is active.

settings.name: PvPStructureDecay
settings.description: If True, enables structures decay on PvP servers while ORP is active.

settings.name: RCONEnabled
settings.description: If True, enables RCON, needs RCONPort and ServerAdminPassword.

settings.name: RCONPort
settings.description: Specifies the optional TCP RCON Port.

settings.name: RCONServerGameLogBuffer
settings.description: Determines how many lines of game logs are sent over RCON.

settings.name: ResourcesRespawnPeriodMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the re-spawn rate for resource nodes.

settings.name: ServerAdminPassword
settings.description: If specified, players must provide this password to gain access to admin commands.

settings.name: ServerCrosshair
settings.description: If False, disables the Crosshair on your server.

settings.name: ServerHardcore
settings.description: If True, enables Hardcore mode (player characters revert to level 1 upon death).

settings.name: ServerPassword
settings.description: If specified, players must provide this password to join the server.

settings.name: serverPVE
settings.description: If True, disables PvP and enables PvE.

settings.name: ShowFloatingDamageText
settings.description: If True, enables RPG-style popup damage text mode.

settings.name: ShowMapPlayerLocation
settings.description: If False, hides each player their own precise position when they view their map.

settings.name: SpectatorPassword
settings.description: To use non-admin spectator, the server must specify a spectator password.

settings.name: StructureDamageMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the damage structures deal.

settings.name: StructurePickupHoldDuration
settings.description: Specifies the quick pick-up hold duration, 0 = instant.

settings.name: StructurePickupTimeAfterPlacement
settings.description: Amount of time in seconds after placement that quick pick-up is available.

settings.name: StructurePreventResourceRadiusMultiplier
settings.description: Same as ResourceNoReplenishRadiusStructures in Game.ini. Can be used as command line too.

settings.name: StructureResistanceMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the resistance to damage structures receive.

settings.name: TamedDinoDamageMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the damage tame creatures deal.

settings.name: TamedDinoResistanceMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the resistance to damage tame creatures receive.

settings.name: TamingSpeedMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for creature taming speed.

settings.name: TheMaxStructuresInRange
settings.description: Specifies the maximum number of structures that can be constructed within a certain range.

settings.name: TributeCharacterExpirationSeconds
settings.description: Set in seconds the expiration timer for uploaded survivors. Default 0 means no expiration.

settings.name: TributeDinoExpirationSeconds
settings.description: Expiration timer for uploaded tames in ARK Data.

settings.name: TributeItemExpirationSeconds
settings.description: Expiration timer for uploaded items in ARK Data.

settings.name: XPMultiplier
settings.description: Specifies the scaling factor for the experience received.

settings.name: Port
settings.description: Specifies the UDP Game Port. Note: command line append syntax is not supported by ASA.

settings.name: QueryPort
settings.description: Specifies the UDP Steam Query Port.

settings.name: SessionName
settings.description: Specifies the Server name advertised in the Game Server Browser.

settings.name: -ClusterDirOverride
settings.description: Specifies cross-server storage location for Cross-ARK Data Transfer. Requires -clusterid.

settings.name: -clusterid
settings.description: Specifies cluster name ID to allow Cross-ARK Data Transfer.

settings.name: -MaxNumOfSaveBackups
settings.description: Set the max number of backup to keep in the save folder.

settings.name: -mods
settings.description: Specifies CurseForge Mod Project IDs. Mods are updated automatically when starting the server.

settings.name: -NoTransferFromFiltering
settings.description: Prevents ARK Data usage between single player and servers who do not have a cluster ID.

settings.name: -passivemods
settings.description: Disables a mod's functionality while still loading its data.

settings.name: -port
settings.description: This is the server port used to host the dedicated server on.

settings.name: -servergamelog
settings.description: Enable server admin logs (including support in the RCON).

settings.name: -servergamelogincludetribelogs
settings.description: Include tribe logs in the normal server game logs.

settings.name: -ServerPlatform
settings.description: Allows the server to accept specified platforms. With no option specified, crossplay is assumed and ALL platforms will be allowed.

settings.name: -ServerRCONOutputTribeLogs
settings.description: Include tribe logs in the RCON output. Requires -servergamelogincludetribelogs.

settings.name: -WinLiveMaxPlayers
settings.description: Sets the maximum of players for the server. Replaces MaxPlayers from GameUserSettings.ini.
